name: @ziyixi/proto-toolchain
description: The pinned protobuf toolchain of this repository (buf, protoc-gen-es, the protobuf-es runtime) and the checks of the proto/ module. Apps consume ./ts (TypeScript) and ./python (Python), never this package.

scripts.test: node tools/ensure.mjs && vitest run && pnpm run test:python && node tools/schema.mjs --check
scripts.test:python: node tools/ensure.mjs && uv run --locked --package ziyixi-proto python -m unittest discover -s test/python -t test/python
